prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Japanese woman, an adult, in her mid 40s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — and between them, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward, her waistline already soft and gently defined even without the pregnancy, now continuing that same soft fullness into the belly's round curve with no harsh transition anywhere. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair skin, pastel pink and lilac eyeshadow, large round eyes enlarged by circle lenses with bright real catchlights, soft round blush, dewy pink lips, a sweet, shy smile, rich chocolate-brown hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head, real pores, real living eyes, 3 hoops piercings set with rubies in silver-toned metal, wearing four to six pieces, layered of silver a ring. Full body fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 37% of the way down her figure from the top and about 69% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET scale formations, VIVID MAGENTA scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied ELECTRIC EMERALD leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID GOLD undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
